item.title: Trump's $48.3b Iran war bill excludes damaged US bases; Democrats press for tally
item.description: The financial cost of the US war against Iran has reached an estimated $48.3 billion. Lawmakers are urging the Pentagon to provide assessments of damages to military bases. Democratic senator Richard Blumenthal pressed for damage estimates during a Senate Armed Services Committee meeting. According to reports, Iranian attacks have resulted in billions of dollars in losses, including damage to key facilities.

item.title: French woman’s €20 flea market find fetches €251,000
item.description: A woman from France stumbled upon a remarkable black ceramic lamp at a local brocante for only €20. Months later, her daughter discovered an inscription revealing the lamp was crafted by Georges Jouve. They reached out to a Paris auction house, which confirmed its authenticity. This led to a stunning auction result of €251,000, setting a record for a Jouve lamp.

item.title: A nuclear blast might be humanity’s best shot at nudging a killer asteroid off course
item.description: In an intriguing twist of space science, researchers are exploring nuclear explosions as a potential solution to divert asteroids threatening Earth. Their latest simulations reveal that the angle of X-ray emissions plays a crucial role in determining how effective these deflections may be. With diverse asteroid shapes adding complexity to the challenge, the developing model aims to offer improved predictions of how asteroids will respond to such drastic measures.

item.title: Isolated tribe Awá emereges from Brazilian Amazon forest amid alarming threats by illegal invaders
item.description: Recently, the elusive Awá tribe, famed for their isolation, reached out to a neighboring settlement in the Arariboia Indigenous territory. In search of food and assistance, their visit exposed the severe impacts of illegal land encroachments. Local villagers documented the meeting, bringing attention to the perils that Indigenous people face. Advocacy groups are demanding stronger safeguards and acknowledgment of the rights of uncontacted tribes to preserve their way of life.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US prosecutor declines charges against white cop who killed Black man
item.description: A police officer in Wisconsin will not be charged for fatally shooting a Black man in July. Prosecutor Ismael Ozanne concluded that the officer acted reasonably in the situation involving Corey Ruiz. Ruiz allegedly resisted arrest, brandished a knife, and was unaffected by Tasers before he was shot. Family members of Ruiz criticized the decision and claimed excessive force was used in the incident.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: 6 dead, including child, after suspected gas explosion levels building in Georgia
item.description: A gas explosion caused a part of an apartment building to collapse in Tbilisi, killing six people. Among the deceased was a child, and several residents remained trapped under the debris. Emergency services rescued a three-year-old girl, who is now in stable condition at a local clinic. Investigations are ongoing into potential safety regulation violations related to the incident.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Ross Defends GTA 6 Gameplay: He denies racial targeting; says he kills everyone
item.description: Adin Ross faced criticism after shooting two Black NPCs during his earlyGTA 6gameplay on November 18. Viewers accused him of targeting characters based on race. The Kick streamer rejected the claims and said he had killed characters from different backgrounds. He also blamed a viewer for sharing a clip that showed only part of his gameplay.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: PS5 Shutdown: Jasontheween loses 11 hours of GTA 6 progress; police visit prompts unconfirmed swatting claims
item.description: Jasontheween lost more than 11 hours of GTA 6 progress after accidentally switching off an extension cord connected to his PS5. The CORE Boys member was left shocked when the game restarted from the prologue. He later asked Rockstar Games and Sony for help. Police also reportedly arrived at his Miami Airbnb, leading to unconfirmed swatting claims.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Skunkape Quest: Players report Bigfoot-like creature; night encounters may unlock quest
item.description: GTA 6 players have discovered Skunkape, a mysterious Bigfoot-like creature hiding near Kingfishers camp south of Hamlet. The encounter reportedly happens at night while playing as Jason, after completing the first mission. Spotting the creature can trigger a hidden quest involving Kirk, with a map marker guiding players towards the next steps. The discovery continues Rockstar's tradition of adding strange creatures and secret mysteries to its games.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Asmongold's Comments: Streamer rates GTA VI 9/10; criticises Jason Duval's character
item.description: Asmongold sparked debate after claiming GTA VI feels like a “female fantasy” and questioning the writing of male protagonist Jason Duval. During a livestream, he described Jason as a traditional boyfriend who lacks an interesting personality. However, the Twitch streamer clarified that he was enjoying Rockstar's latest release. Despite criticising parts of its story and calling them “femslop,” he rated GTA VI nine out of ten.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Asmongold Rates GTA 6 9/10: Asmongold criticises Jason Duval; says he enjoyed the game
item.description: Twitch streamer Asmongold has called GTA 6 a "female fantasy" and questioned how Rockstar Games has written Jason Duval. During his November 18 livestream, he described Jason as a traditional boyfriend who was not very interesting. However, he made it clear that he was enjoying the game and gave it a 9/10 rating.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: First Gameplay Reactions: Streamers uncover GTA VI glitches; celebrity references spark online talk
item.description: Adin Ross, Kai Cenat, IShowSpeed and xQc were among the first streamers to play Rockstar Games’ GTA VI following its early international release. Their livestreams quickly went viral, featuring unexpected character interactions, gameplay glitches, police chases and bizarre encounters. From IShowSpeed’s shower scene to Adin Ross triggering a three-star wanted level, the streamers’ reactions have added to the excitement surrounding the long-awaited game's release.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk
